architecture_contract.unsupported_rule: Reject with ILLEGAL_INST before handler operand reads, state effects, memory effects, or TPC advance.
architecture_contract.retirement_rule: Every successful non-start/non-stop command advances TPC by its encoded instruction length; start and stop own their control transfer.
architecture_contract.argument_rule: All six B.ARG forms retain distinct three-bit argument-kind state; the dynamic form also records its decoded value.
architecture_contract.hint_rule: B.HINT records the complete encoded payload and advances the hint epoch but has no PTO-v0 scheduling effect.
architecture_contract.metadata_rule: B.DIM, B.TEXT, B.IOR, B.IOT, B.CATR, and B.DATR consume every decoded field into trap-preserved bundle state. PTO-v0 tile commit consumes only B.IOT slot 0 destination/source bindings and the descriptor data type; all other stored metadata has no payload effect in this profile.
architecture_contract.memory_rule: MCOPY and MSET accept lengths 0 through 63 bytes and reject larger XLEN values without truncation or partial effects.
architecture_contract.bridge_rule: The PTO-v0 bundle bridge binds destination0, source0, and source1 only; operations needing any other operand reject at commit before tile effects.

independent_comparison.limitation: The independent snapshot predates eight accepted PTO 0.58.0 command encoding changes and stages bundle payload execution, so it neither matches those masks nor validates PTO tile payload effects; ADR 0045, ADR 0054, the PTO catalogs, and PTO-owned ASL evidence remain authoritative.
